regions.name: South Devon
regions.summary: Bass on soft plastics and surface lures from estuaries, open beaches and Brixham Breakwater. Charter boats finding medium pollack and bass. Smoothhounds and spotted ray on the boat marks. Thick-lipped mullet, garfish and ballan wrasse from harbour walls.
regions.note: The report does not state its date, so treat it as recent rather than this week.

sources.t: Charter boats finding bass and pollack
